name: Gasthof Christophorus
beschreibung: The Gasthof Christophorus is located in Söll in the Tiroler Unterland. The accommodation offers guests rooms in a traditional inn. The room furnishings are functional and practical. The on-site restaurant serves Tiroler Spezialitäten. The surrounding area is characterized by meadows and forests. Hiking trails start right at the doorstep. The cable cars of the SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser-Brixental are within walking distance. The inn is suitable for guests seeking a quiet stay.
